Question
========
For each of the following, decide whether it is best described as structured, semi-structured or unstructured data. Type one of the three words for each item.

Answerlist
----------
* A folder containing hundreds of audio files.
* The `stops.txt` file from a GTFS feed.
* A Wikipedia article.
* The configuration file of a video game.


Solution
========
* A folder of audio files has no shared organizational scheme beyond the file system itself, so it counts as unstructured data.
* The `stops.txt` file from a GTFS feed is a plain table with fixed columns (stop ID, name, coordinates, ...), which makes it structured data.
* A Wikipedia article has some organizational properties, such as headings, an infobox and links, but it does not follow a rigid row-and-column format, so it counts as semi-structured data.
* A game's configuration file (for example in JSON or XML) also has organizational properties without being strictly tabular, so it is semi-structured data as well.

Answerlist
----------
* unstructured
* structured
* semi-structured
* semi-structured
